parsed.attack: Medisafe is the incumbent: tens of millions of users, and it already ships Medfriend, a named caregiver seat alerted when a dose is missed, plus caregiver multi-profile management. Putting the administering sibling's name on the dose row is a column in a schema they already have, not a product, and they would ship it in a quarter for the caregiving segment they already sell to. Apple is the second front - Health already logs Medications and already shares that log with a family member, so 'logged by' fits inside Health Sharing. And the free competitor is the one named in the pain: the WhatsApp group chat, where every line is already attributed and timestamped.
parsed.strongest_defence: None of them will make the record append-only. Medisafe's log is a checklist anyone can silently untick and Apple's Medications is self-logging by the patient, a stance Apple will not change because a caregiver administration record carries clinical liability it deliberately avoids. An incumbent cannot ship a log its own user is forbidden to quietly correct, and that refusal, plus the spoken attribution, is the whole product.
parsed.verdict_reason: Medisafe can add caregiver attribution trivially and would kill the stated wedge, but the append-only, voice-attributed correction is a posture the incumbents structurally will not adopt.
